entities.name: Identification procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure used by the network to request a UE to provide specific identification parameters such as identity or capabilities.

entities.name: IDENTITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to request identity information from the UE.

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE in response to an IDENTITY REQUEST, containing the requested identity information.

entities.name: Identity type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of identity requested by the network (e.g., IMSI, IMEI).

entities.name: Mobile identity
entities.description: Information element containing the actual identity information provided by the UE.

relations.description: The identification procedure includes sending an IDENTITY REQUEST message.
The identification procedure includes receiving an IDENTITY RESPONSE message.
The IDENTITY REQUEST message contains the Identity type information element.
The IDENTITY RESPONSE message contains the Mobile identity information element.
